candidate_rules: Filter each frozen ranked scan without backfilling. Compare current eligibility to immediately preceding scheduled scan; reset on missing scan, exclusion, lane change or session boundary. New observation start strictly increases; current close must exceed prior eligible close only for second candidate. Preserve baseline rank and current actual detection clocks. Freeze ALL candidate predictions before opening labels. No other filters or tuning.

candidates.hypothesis: Require repeated eligibility with fresh price evidence to reject a transient three-minute volume-ratio burst; accept the extra scan latency.
In addition to persistence, require a higher observed close between scans so repeated volume without continued price response does not suffice.

error_analysis: Compare all 65 two-minute certified negatives to 19 positives with detection-time trace and prefix fields only. Unknown fields stay missing. Descriptive grouping only, no parameter selection from group results. Outcomes are join labels only.

success.interpretation: All criteria must pass for development success; any claim of improvement requires later unchanged March validation, not authorized in this study.
